configuracion.ayudaVelocidad: Changes only presentation speed in Phaser.
configuracion.ayudaEfectos: Reduces secondary effects without changing gameplay.
configuracion.ayudaZoom: Defines how the camera starts. The mouse wheel and zoom keys still work during play.

juego.controles: MOVEMENT: arrows, WASD, or numpad. Press Space or 5 to wait one turn. COMBAT: f INTERACT: r
juego.mensajeInicial: Begin the adventure and explore the map.

personaje.dpsAyuda: Average raw damage per second. Includes attack speed, but not accuracy, critical hits, armor, or block.
personaje.danioMagicoAyuda: Multiplier derived from Intelligence and Wisdom used by magical skills.
personaje.potenciaEfectosAyuda: Multiplier derived from Wisdom and Intelligence. Each effect defines whether it scales value, duration, or both.

curacion.subtitulo: Restore your resources before a new expedition.
curacion.introduccion: The price depends only on the points you need to recover.
curacion.descripcionTodo: Restores Life and Mana in a single operation.

mensajes.preferenciasInvalidas: Saved preferences were invalid. Default values were used.
mensajes.preferenciasGuardadas: Preferences saved. They will apply when the game starts.

mensajes.fullscreenError: Fullscreen mode could not be changed.

mazmorras.subtitulo: Choose a dungeon and set the expedition level.
mazmorras.bloqueoNivel: You need to reach level {nivel} to access this expedition.

comercio.subtitulo: Buy supplies or sell loot from your expeditions.
comercio.detalleVacio: Select an item to review its details and price.

inventario.resumen: Inventory: {ocupadas} of {capacidad} slots occupied, weight {peso}, and {oro} gold coins.

derrota.descripcion: The darkness brought this adventure to an end.

detalleObjeto.sinDescripcion: This item has no description available.
detalleObjeto.sinPropiedades: This item has no special properties.

comparacionObjetos.sinOpciones: There are no other equipped items to compare.
comparacionObjetos.sinDiferenciasAfijos: The items have no affix differences.
comparacionObjetos.subtitulo: The comparison is informational and does not change equipment.

guerrero.descripcion: A resilient fighter who can alternate between weapon and shield or two-handed weapons.
guerrero.estiloJuego: Protection, blocking, and direct physical damage.

rogue.descripcion: An agile fighter who combines fast daggers with accurate ranged attacks.
rogue.estiloJuego: Speed, evasion, critical hits, and weapon swapping.

mago.descripcion: An Intelligence-focused adventurer who uses staves or wands to channel magical abilities.
mago.estiloJuego: Range, Mana, and specialization in spells.

guerrero_espada_escudo.descripcion: A balanced setup with good defense, blocking, and steady damage.

guerrero_hacha_escudo.descripcion: Stronger but less accurate blows while maintaining the same overall protection.

guerrero_lanza.descripcion: Uses range two and compensates for the lack of a shield with a complete medium set.

guerrero_mandoble.descripcion: Sacrifices blocking to start with the highest physical damage among Tier I weapons.

rogue_daga_arco.descripcion: Starts with a dagger equipped and keeps the bow and quiver as a ranged alternative.

rogue_arco_preparado.descripcion: Starts attacking at range with the bow and quiver already equipped.

rogue_doble_daga.descripcion: Increases melee pressure with two daggers while keeping the bow in the inventory.

mago_baston.descripcion: Recommended two-handed setup with steady damage based on Intelligence.

mago_varita_escudo.descripcion: Trades offensive damage for range, blocking, and stronger starting defense.

mago_baston_viajero.descripcion: Keeps the staff and redistributes light pieces while preserving the same total armor.

capucha_tela.descripcion: A simple cloth hood that protects the head without adding unnecessary weight.

tunica_aprendiz.descripcion: A light robe used by apprentices and travelers who value freedom of movement.

guantes_tela.descripcion: Light gloves offering minimal protection without hindering hand movement.

pantalones_tela.descripcion: Comfortable cloth trousers suited to long journeys and exploration.

botas_tela.descripcion: Light boots that trade protection for an agile step.

capucha_tela_reforzada.descripcion: A hood made from several layers of durable cloth.

tunica_reforzada.descripcion: A reinforced robe that improves protection without losing flexibility.

guantes_tela_reforzados.descripcion: Reinforced gloves that protect the hands while preserving freedom of movement.

pantalones_tela_reforzados.descripcion: Layered trousers that provide improved light protection.

botas_tela_reforzadas.descripcion: Light reinforced boots suited to quick movement.

capucha_cuero.descripcion: Flexible leather protection for the head.

jubon_acolchado.descripcion: Flexible torso protection suitable for beginning an adventure.

guantes_cuero.descripcion: Leather gloves that protect the hands without greatly limiting movement.

pantalones_cuero.descripcion: Flexible leather protection for the legs.

capucha_cuero_endurecido.descripcion: A treated leather hood that improves protection without becoming rigid.

jubon_cuero_endurecido.descripcion: A hardened leather jerkin balancing protection, weight, and mobility.

guantes_cuero_endurecido.descripcion: Treated leather gloves that protect the hands during prolonged fights.

pantalones_cuero_endurecido.descripcion: Trousers reinforced with hardened leather for better leg protection.

botas_cuero_endurecido.descripcion: Durable hardened-leather boots prepared for hostile terrain.

casco_hierro.descripcion: An iron helmet that provides solid head protection.

coraza_hierro.descripcion: A heavy iron cuirass designed to withstand direct blows.

guantes_hierro.descripcion: Metal gauntlets that protect the hands at the cost of extra weight.

botas_hierro.descripcion: Iron boots providing firm protection for the feet.

casco_acero.descripcion: A durable steel helmet prepared for high-risk encounters.

coraza_acero.descripcion: A steel cuirass providing superior defense against physical attacks.

guantes_acero.descripcion: Reinforced steel gauntlets protecting the hands and forearms.

grebas_acero.descripcion: Steel greaves designed to withstand heavy blows to the legs.

botas_acero.descripcion: Heavy steel boots completing a front-line defense.

escudo_madera.descripcion: A basic shield that provides armor and a chance to block part of incoming damage.

escudo_hierro.descripcion: A heavy iron shield that improves armor and blocking.

daga_hierro.descripcion: A light, accurate dagger specialized in fast attacks and critical strikes.

daga_acero.descripcion: A balanced steel dagger for very fast attacks and frequent critical strikes.

espada_larga.descripcion: A balanced sword combining good damage, accuracy, and speed.

espada_acero.descripcion: A reliable steel sword, more damaging and accurate than its iron counterpart.

hacha_mano.descripcion: A one-handed weapon with strong blows, though less accurate than a sword.

hacha_batalla.descripcion: A one-handed steel axe that favors heavy blows over accuracy.

mandoble_hierro.descripcion: A slow, inaccurate two-handed heavy sword capable of dealing great damage.

mandoble_acero.descripcion: A massive two-handed steel blade capable of devastating damage.

lanza.descripcion: A two-handed weapon combining a firm thrust with the ability to attack from one extra tile away.

lanza_reforzada.descripcion: A reinforced spear with improved damage that keeps control of corridors at range two.

arco_corto.descripcion: An accurate ranged bow that requires an equipped quiver.

arco_recurvo.descripcion: A stronger, more accurate recurve bow with greater range that still requires a quiver.

baston_aprendiz.descripcion: A two-handed staff that channels the wielder’s Intelligence and empowers magical abilities.

baston_reforzado.descripcion: A reinforced two-handed staff offering stronger magical channeling.

varita_fuego_aprendiz.descripcion: A one-handed wand attuned to Fire. It channels abilities and prepares a magical discharge without ammunition.

varita_frio_aprendiz.descripcion: A one-handed wand attuned to Frost. It channels abilities and prepares a magical discharge without ammunition.

varita_electrica_aprendiz.descripcion: A one-handed wand attuned to Lightning. It channels abilities and prepares a magical discharge without ammunition.

varita_veneno_aprendiz.descripcion: A one-handed wand attuned to Poison. It channels abilities and prepares a magical discharge without ammunition.

varita_fuego_canalizada.descripcion: A one-handed wand attuned to Fire and prepared to channel more powerful abilities.

varita_frio_canalizada.descripcion: A one-handed wand attuned to Frost and prepared to channel more powerful abilities.

varita_electrica_canalizada.descripcion: A one-handed wand attuned to Lightning and prepared to channel more powerful abilities.

varita_veneno_canalizada.descripcion: A one-handed wand attuned to Poison and prepared to channel more powerful abilities.

pocion_curacion.descripcion: A small potion that restores a significant amount of Life.

pocion_mana.descripcion: A small potion that restores a significant amount of Mana.

quiver_cuero.descripcion: A simple leather quiver with room for one stack of arrows.

cola_rata.descripcion: The severed tail of a sewer rat. It can be kept as proof of a hunt or used in unpleasant preparations.

caparazon_cucaracha.descripcion: A hard, durable fragment from the carapace of a giant cockroach.

hueso_esqueleto.descripcion: An old bone once animated by dark energy. It still carries a faint unnatural chill.

carne_putrefacta.descripcion: A piece of decomposed flesh. Its smell leaves little doubt about its origin.

hueso_negro.descripcion: A bone fragment hardened and darkened by malignant energy. It is far tougher than an ordinary bone.

flecha_madera.descripcion: A simple wooden arrow with a metal tip.

afilado.descripcion: Increases only the weapon’s minimum physical damage, making its hits more consistent.

brutal.descripcion: Increases the weapon’s local physical damage by a percentage.

ligero.descripcion: Would increase the weapon’s local attack speed.

sanguinario.descripcion: Would add physical damage to all attacks.

del_conquistador.descripcion: Would increase all physical damage by a percentage.

despiadado.descripcion: Would grant additional multiplicative physical damage.

fortificado.descripcion: Would increase the item’s base Armor by a percentage.

ardiente.descripcion: Adds local Fire damage to the weapon’s basic attack.

glacial.descripcion: Adds local Frost damage to the weapon’s basic attack.

electrificado.descripcion: Adds local Lightning damage to the weapon’s basic attack.

venenoso.descripcion: Adds local Poison damage to the weapon’s basic attack.

igneo.descripcion: Would increase one elemental damage type by a percentage.

invernal.descripcion: Would increase one elemental damage type by a percentage.

tempestuoso.descripcion: Would increase one elemental damage type by a percentage.

toxico.descripcion: Would increase one elemental damage type by a percentage.

abrasador.descripcion: Would grant a chance to Burn.

congelante.descripcion: Would grant a chance to Freeze.

aturdidor.descripcion: Would grant a chance to Stun.

ponzonoso.descripcion: Would grant a chance to Poison.

de_absorcion.descripcion: Increases the percentage of damage mitigated when blocking.

de_fatalidad.descripcion: Would increase the critical chance of all attacks.

de_carniceria.descripcion: Would increase the critical multiplier of all attacks.

de_renovacion.descripcion: Would regenerate a percentage of maximum Life.

de_meditacion.descripcion: Would regenerate a percentage of maximum Mana.

del_vampiro.descripcion: Would recover Life based on damage dealt.

del_devorador.descripcion: Would recover Mana based on damage dealt.

de_fortuna.descripcion: Would increase the quality of items found.

de_abundancia.descripcion: Would increase the quantity of items found.

del_archimago.descripcion: Would increase Mana and spell power.

ascua.descripcion: Launches a concentrated ember that deals immediate Fire damage to one enemy.

explosion_ignea.descripcion: Detonates a mass of fire on a tile, damaging all enemies within the radius.

incinerar.descripcion: Projects a line of fire through enemies, dealing immediate damage and possibly applying Burn.

esquirla_hielo.descripcion: Fires a shard that deals Frost damage and temporarily slows the enemy’s movement.

nova_escarcha.descripcion: Releases a wave of cold around the caster that damages and slows nearby enemies.

rafaga_glacial.descripcion: Launches an intense burst of icy fragments that deals Frost damage and has a 60% base chance to apply Freeze.

chispa.descripcion: Releases a quick spark that deals Lightning damage and temporarily delays the enemy’s actions.

cadena_rayos.descripcion: Releases lightning that jumps between nearby enemies without striking the same target twice.

descarga_fulminante.descripcion: Launches a linear discharge through enemies, dealing Lightning damage and independently attempting to Stun each target.

aguijon_toxico.descripcion: Fires a venomous sting that deals immediate damage and leaves a temporary toxin.

nube_toxica.descripcion: Creates a persistent cloud that poisons enemies already inside, those who enter, and those who remain within it.

plaga_corrosiva.descripcion: Infects an enemy with Poisoning and can intensify a single instance up to the maximum for each rank.

curacion_lunar.descripcion: Lythra channels moonlight to fully restore the target’s missing Life.

restauracion_mana_lunar.descripcion: Lythra channels lunar energy to fully restore the target’s missing Mana.

alcantarilla.descripcion: Damp, narrow tunnels infested with vermin. A ratman scavenger occasionally ventures through the passages in search of abandoned items.

cementerio.descripcion: An abandoned graveyard where skeleton guards and archers patrol among the crypts. A zombie may emerge as an uncommon encounter.

casa_guerrero.descripcion: An old military residence turned into a training ground for undead warriors. A Bone Knight occasionally guards its halls.

fortaleza_abandonada.descripcion: A ruined fortification occupied by thieves and spearmen who exploit its defensive corridors. A Commander may organize the resistance.

sala_guerra.descripcion: The military core of the fortress, where fighters from earlier expeditions gather under the Warlord’s command.

ciudad_inicial.descripcion: A safe town where expeditions begin and end.

mercader_refugio.descripcion: A refuge merchant who buys loot and prepares supplies for new expeditions.

curandera_refugio.descripcion: An elven healer who tends to those returning wounded or exhausted from the dungeons.
